userStories.title: Add optional type field to the issue schema (both copies) and IssueEntry
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need the issue schema to carry an optional type field (enum feat|fix|chore|docs) so that downstream PR-title and label derivation has a typed signal on every issue.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/cam/issues.schema.json declares an optional 'type' property with enum [feat, fix, chore, docs]. [oracle: grep -q '"chore"' scripts/cam/issues.schema.json]
templates/scripts/cam/issues.schema.json declares the same optional 'type' property with enum [feat, fix, chore, docs]. [oracle: grep -q '"chore"' templates/scripts/cam/issues.schema.json]

'type' is NOT added to any required array in either schema copy (it is optional; default feat is applied by consumers on read, per US-004/US-005). [oracle: file-assert: grep the required arrays in both copies and confirm 'type' is absent]
IssueEntry in src/issues/types.ts gains an optional type field typed to the same four-value union. [oracle: grep -q "type?:" src/issues/types.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
Vendor drift check passes (bun run embed-vendor:check). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
userStories.notes: AUDITOR FIX (finding 1): the two schema copies are NOT byte-identical today and must NOT be made so. scripts/cam/issues.schema.json carries specSource, derivedFrom, and allOf conditional blocks that templates/scripts/cam/issues.schema.json intentionally lacks (repo invariant: cam dual-copy is per-file). Do NOT sync those blocks and do NOT use a full-file diff as an oracle; add the type enum block to each copy independently and verify with the targeted greps above. Files: scripts/cam/issues.schema.json, templates/scripts/cam/issues.schema.json, src/issues/types.ts. Touching templates/ requires bun run embed-vendor before commit.

userStories.title: Accept and persist type through cam spec --persist
userStories.description: As the orchestrator, I need cam spec --persist to accept an optional type in the stdin payload and persist it onto the issue file so that the grill outcome durably records the issue type.
acceptanceCriteria: The SpecPersistPayload in src/commands/spec.ts accepts an optional top-level type and forwards it to specifyIssueOnMain. [oracle: bun test test/issue-specify.test.ts]

specifyIssueOnMain (src/commands/issue-specify.ts) persists type onto the issue entry when present; a payload without type leaves the issue entry without a type key (no default is written to disk). [oracle: bun test test/issue-specify.test.ts]

A payload with a type value outside [feat, fix, chore, docs] fails validation with a named error (reason surfaces on stderr and CAM_SPEC_RESULT=ERROR), never a silent drop. [oracle: bun test test/issue-specify.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/spec.ts (SpecPersistPayload + pass-through), src/commands/issue-specify.ts (SpecifyIssueOnMainOptions + write onto IssueEntry, validation alongside the existing invalid-spec/invalid-wsjf paths), test/issue-specify.test.ts. Depends on US-001 (IssueEntry.type). type is a TOP-LEVEL issue field like specSource, not a field inside spec: do not touch the Spec interface in src/issues/spec.ts. Default feat is applied on READ by consumers (US-004 planner, US-005 composer), never written to the file.

userStories.title: composePrTitle emits <type>: <text> (CAM-<N>)
userStories.description: As a repo maintainer, I need the PR title (and thus the squash-commit subject on main) to be a deterministic conventional-commit string tied to the issue, so that history is scannable and classifyBump gets a clean signal.
acceptanceCriteria: PrdSnapshot in src/release/pr-body.ts gains an optional type field, and ShipPrdRecord/toPrdSnapshot in src/supervisor/ship-runner.ts carry it through from prd.json. [oracle: bun test test/pr-body.test.ts]
composePrTitle returns '<type>: <descriptive PRD text> (CAM-<issueNumber>)': no scope, no truncation, type defaults to feat when the snapshot lacks one. [oracle: bun test test/pr-body.test.ts]
The issue reference is textual 'CAM-<N>', never '#<N>' (a #N would link to an unrelated GitHub entity). [oracle: bun test test/pr-body.test.ts asserting the title contains 'CAM-' and no '#']
When issueNumber is null/absent, the title cleanly omits the ' (CAM-<N>)' suffix without trailing whitespace or parentheses. [oracle: bun test test/pr-body.test.ts]

composePrTitle stays a pure, self-contained composer over prdSnapshot: no filesystem/git/issue-file reads added to pr-body.ts. [oracle: file-assert: grep confirms no new import of node:fs/Bun.file/issue modules in src/release/pr-body.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/release/pr-body.ts (PrdSnapshot + composePrTitle), src/supervisor/ship-runner.ts (ShipPrdRecord + toPrdSnapshot), test/pr-body.test.ts. Gotcha (from issue spec): squashMergeCommitTitle=COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE, so with multiple commits the PR title becomes the squash subject on main and feeds classifyBump (bonus, not the driver: bump is already computed from branch commits). Keep the existing description/project fallback chain for the descriptive text. Depends on US-004 (PRD carries type). Grep scripts/cam/patterns.md for 'pr-body' / 'ship' bullets before coding.

userStories.title: ship-pr applies the type-derived GitHub label on PR creation
userStories.description: As a repo maintainer, I need gh pr create to apply exactly one type-derived label (feat->enhancement, fix->bug, docs->documentation, chore->none) so that PRs are classified at creation with the repo's existing labels.
acceptanceCriteria: runShipPrStep (src/release/ship-pr.ts) derives the label from prdSnapshot.type via the map feat->enhancement, fix->bug, docs->documentation and appends '--label <label>' to the gh pr create argv; absent type behaves as feat. [oracle: bun test test/ship-pr.test.ts asserting the spawn argv]

type=chore produces NO --label flag, and no label other than the mapped type label is ever added. [oracle: bun test test/ship-pr.test.ts asserting the argv contains no --label for chore and exactly one for the others]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/release/ship-pr.ts (label map + argv in step 2 of runShipPrStep), test/ship-pr.test.ts (spawnFn fake already captures argv). Gotchas (from issue spec): gh pr create --label fails if the label does not exist in the repo; enhancement, bug, documentation already exist (verified via gh label list), chore intentionally maps to no label. gh mutation calls keep the stripGithubToken() env handling: do not change it. Depends on US-005 (PrdSnapshot.type).
